history.summary: Plan completed and committed (AnsibleSpecs 5753753): task shape pre-settled; six phases (guard, one-invocation apply, prevent_destroy, runbook switch, doctrine in ../AnsibleSpecs, scheduled-job stage independence and signals); 17 outcome-level acceptance criteria covering R1-R4. Dry-run parses; two out-of-scope observations appended to close-out (S1 host-installed guard, S2 stale ignore_changes comments).

One blocking finding: once P3 adds prevent_destroy, Terraform rejects a VM delete or replace at plan time, so P1's guard never runs for a VM, and a VM replace in the drift job reads as ordinary drift, against the settled ruling and V08; one advisory on wrong citations.
